title: Feasibility problem for the radii of Steiner 4-chains
summary: Motivated by the solution of Descartes famous problem on the chains of tangent circles given by D.Mathews and O.Zymaris, we give an algorithmic solution to the feasibility problem for radii of Steiner 4-chains studied by K.Kirajiev. More precisely, we obtain a complete characterization of the ordered quadruples of positive numbers which coincide with a quadruple of curvatures of the circles forming a Steiner 4-chain.
